topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for StakeStone. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 23 contract row(s) across base, berachain, bsc, ethereum, linea, mantle, merlin, scroll. Structural roles: 15 core, 5 supporting, 3 unclassified. No upgradeable pattern was identified in these rows.
